title: Maximize Subarray Sum After Removing All Occurrences of One Element
summary: Given an integer array nums, you can remove all instances of one integer x to maximize the subarray sum of the resulting array.
statement: Given an integer array nums, you can remove all instances of one integer x to maximize the subarray sum of the resulting array. Find the maximum possible subarray sum after performing this operation at most once.
constraints: nums has 1–100,000 integers with absolute value at most one million.
At most once, choose one value and remove every occurrence of that value; choosing no value is allowed.
Return the maximum nonempty subarray sum after the optional removal.
hints: Only removing a negative value can increase a subarray sum, and deletion acts like a zero that connects its neighbors.
Maintain total, prefix, suffix, and best subarray values in a segment tree; temporarily zero all positions of each negative value.
Build once, update one value group to zero, read the root answer, then restore that group.
All updates across groups total O(n), while the segment tree exactly recomputes the best connected interval after each trial.
editorial: All updates across groups total O(n), while the segment tree exactly recomputes the best connected interval after each trial.

tests.explanation: Removing every -2 joins the useful regions and produces maximum sum seven.
Removing -1 joins the two positive values for sum two.
